book.name: Yittsadhaanasa Waadimano
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaana Eenasa Waadimano

content: Bhawloos Moqodooniabee Girikbedar Kinin Yivoono
Ogo gooren woyonsa budonte, Bhawloos Barjodar woylamin qajayna eenaam yikal eelayse keam kiilate ki wocchinsade; ogora keam nagaysayse Moqodoonia peendar ki yivade.
Peen ogoka sagaate yinin yivenka, Barjodar woylamin qajaana eenaam thoothi kiilimeka keam wocchinsayse Girik peendar ki yivade.

Ogotear arpi makkam yinin dooqonsa budonte bazindara sagadhen gonngalante ardayse Sooria peendar yivota kinin hayenka, Ayiwd eena kina siya kenin ooshonam dhesayse Moqodooniaka maatayse yivota ki qaabade.

Beeria kataman ea Bhirhus naasa Sobhathirosbee, Teselonqe kataman eena Aristhirokoosbee, Sikondusbee, Derbe kataman ea Gayoosbee, pir Thimaatoosbee, Isiya peen eena Tikiqoosbee, Thiropimoosbe kimbesana kinka ke yivade.
Kedi woam birayse yivayse Thirovadda gidir ke toolade.
Wodiar irshonin qolmin balashan kummadhen bavaalinsa budonte, Pilbhisoos katamara bazindara sagadhen gonngalanka dhaabhayse rooroa dongsoaka Thirovaddar kekal yeskayse rooro tobbhaa ogote wo dooqade.
Bhawloos Thirovaddar Kisa Macchino Yaayeno
Gabansa bira rooroa balashanam kashate kinka kummota bukayse wo daaka, Bhawloos sedhiman yivota yinin hayenka, bukaana eenana giyada dhalqinamaar sootin kiaddha lamanka yekka ki gudubhsade.
Wonin bukon ooninsa zulonte woysadhon ooninte thoothi shaaka ko dahade.

Ewtheekis hambhea naasi barsh kalaa ooninsa maskootindar ki dooqade. Bhawloos dhalqinam kinin gudubhsonna naasa agaam kattsi gindhe kiam ko yedade; gindhenin kiam bashonna, ooninsa zulonte woysadhon oonin makkansonsa maskootra mia ki dhambade; eenin kiam dhaasenka, diyayse ki dahade.
Bhawloosaar hanchayse naasadar yirk hamayse naasaam incayse eenna “Kidi sadaka daane; targadheebhode!” kena ki hamade.
Ogora Bhawloos maatate utayse Barjodar woylamin qajayna eenabesana kinka balashanam ki itsade. Peenin sedhenka yekka eenbesana kinka dhalqayse ki yivade.
Eenaar dhaqaa naasaam kisa oonindar ke tiyade; ogonante kedi wozadhayse kattsi ke wocchimbhade.
Bhawloos Thirovaddara Milithi Katamandar Kinin Yivoono
Bhawloos Asoos kataman rooka yivota yinin qaabonna, birayse wodi ogote yeskayse kiam wo tiye ki zagade. Ogonante bazindara sagadhen gonngalante ardayse Asoos katamandar wo yivade.
Asoos gidir Bhawloosbesana kinka keerayse bazindara sagadhen gonngalanka kiam tiyayse Mithilin katamandar wo yivade.
Burin ogora dhaabhayse Kiyoos peensa birante dohon raqindar wo yeskade; ogoraar kina hamon dhaabhayse Saamoosdar yivayse kina hamon Milithi kataman wo yeskade.
Bhawloos Isiya gidir kappana yinin zagaamonna, Epsoon ardima sagayse yivota ki qaabade. Ogonoar, yi damidianna, Bhentheqosthe bavaalam Yerusaalem gidir saskana zagayse ki gibade.
Bhawloos Epsoon Misken Ooninsa Donzanabesana Kinka Kinin Dhalqoono
Bhawloos Milithi katamara Epsoon katamante eedi yittsayse misken ooninsa donzanaam yikal ki elsade.
Kikal ke nivaysaka kena yin ki giyade: “Isiya gidir inin ardorra yedayse rooro wul yembesana kinka hamin inin dohonam yedi dheseeda dhese.
Ayiwd eena idar siya hayota ooshayse gaalebee eepibeam ke bavaakaar inta metenam isa toskayse Imbaa wontea Yesusna i waadadhade.
Thoothin eenin buken raqintebee yesa onnarbe yeam i dhettsade; yena pooten wulam inin giyenka shiishaatine.
Ayiwd eenabee Ayiwdtay hamma eenabe seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar ke maatebee wosa Imbaa Yesus Kiristoosdar woylamin ke qajebe hamayse wocchinsayse kena i tarjade.
Taar iam Manpas Gazano kantaka konin dhaasonna Yerusaalem ida yive. Ogote har idar yeskenam dhesattine;
ko dahaannaar dhaxibee gaalebe idar konin yeskenam Manpas Gazano kataman wul gidir ina wocchinsayse koda giye.
Inta gobenbee Imbaa wontea Yesuskalanka inin tiyoono waadimanbeam inin macchoadettsi, ogo Barjosa sunin imintonsa dhacchintan upsinam giyana ‘Sadano inno ina poota ko poote’ hamayse qaabattine.
“Taar marrato! Inta Barjosa bitamon goynsa giyada ye wulsa shaarinte inin yaayoono keeda kaara os iam yenin haapiminam dhesayda dhese.
Ogonante inta een wulsa zombhira gaza ea inin maatenam kina rooroaka yena ida tarje.
Harrna hambhidianna, Barjosa qaabon wulam yena giyara hamin ko dahaakaar shiishaatine.
Yisa Naasasa zombhinka kinin shanoono Barjosa misken ooninam yenin tooloadettsi Manpas Gazano yeam misken ooninam toolayna hayayse konin kamonna, Barjo een wulbee yennon metenbeam gishee.
Inin yivonsa budonte yaanana burqadhima sarea yaayodettsi maatayna eena yesa shaarinte kenin ardenam dhesayda dhese.
Tapir yesa shaarira waani waani eena dhaabhayse wobon dhalqinam giyaate Barjodar woylamin qajayna eenaam yidar keda maase.
Ogonante leve makkam sootinbee rooronbe eepada ye kalaa kalaana inin kiilonam bhocchada qaymayse toolee.
“Taar Barjobee kisa sunin imintonsa upsinbena yeam inta elqimidine; ogono upsino yeam wocchinsanabee gazisadhaana wulsa shaarinte raq yena imana dameabene.
Inta haysaar birrebee, worqibee, apalabe anngardhaatine.
Inta aanin innonka imbee imbesana waadadhaynabena zaskenam waadadhayse inin haaponam yedi yenti dheseeda dhese.

‘Tiyea eadara imea kattsi gobshadhaane’ hamayno Imbaa wontea Yesussa dhalqinam bhocchintaka idettsi waadadhaate eedi kantaysa qolminaam kelsha woam zaskenam goyti wulka yena inta dhaydine” kena ki hamade.
Ogoam yinin giyonsa budonte Bhawloos kumpurdhayse ke wulbesana Barjoam ki miskade.
Kedi wulaar kattsi eepaate Bhawloosam incayse ke sunqade.
Kattsi qaabonka kenin atoono “Keeda kaara os iam haapattene” kinin hamonnane. Ogora bazindara sagadhen gonngalankal kimbesana yivayse kiam ke suudade.
